UX surface Shared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

LANG_SLUGS

Localized route slugs per locale — the path segments after the locale prefix. English is canonical/un-prefixed; every other locale maps its routes through this table (/br/sobre, /de/nutzungsbedingungen, …). CMS may override these at runtime via translations/<loc>/slugs.

Slugs are ASCII-folded (no diacritics — ueber not über, termes-d-us not termes-d'ús) so URLs survive servers and clients that mishandle percent-encoded UTF-8, and stay readable when pasted into plain-text contexts.
